hunt.name: Blinder Tunnel .csproj Hijacking and C2
hunt.description: The adversary targets software engineers with weaponized Visual Studio projects to gain a foothold in critical infrastructure. This hunt starts by finding developer workstations where MSBuild has been manipulated to create files in non-standard subdirectories of the Local AppData folder. It analyzes the execution of renamed binaries from these directories and correlates them with follow-on GitHub API traffic or Chisel tunneling. An agent weighs these phased results, and an analyst confirms the suppression of event tracing.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%visual studio%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%msbuild%'
config.description: Focus the hunt on hosts with Visual Studio or MSBuild, as these are the primary targets for weaponized project files.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames belonging to software engineers or developers. Silence means the estate lacks standard developer tooling.

primitive_config.label: Identify developer workstations

primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames belonging to software engineers or developers. Silence means the estate lacks standard developer tooling.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%msbuild.exe' AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\microsoft\runtimebrokers\%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify instances where msbuild.exe creates files in the non-standard RuntimeBrokers path as specified in the report.
config.expected_signal: Creation of RuntimeBroker.exe, RuntimeBroker.exe.config, or RuntimeBroker.dll in a local appdata folder by MSBuild.

primitive_config.label: MSBuild writing to AppData subfolders
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%msbuild.exe' AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\microsoft\runtimebrokers\%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Creation of RuntimeBroker.exe, RuntimeBroker.exe.config, or RuntimeBroker.dll in a local appdata folder by MSBuild.

config.content: SELECT process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS run_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\microsoft\runtimebrokers\runtimebroker.exe' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_path HAVING host_count <= 5 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Identify the execution of RuntimeBroker.exe from the non-standard Local AppData path used by the hijack.
config.expected_signal: A binary named RuntimeBroker.exe running from a user's Local AppData folder. Silence suggests no such hijack has occurred.

primitive_config.label: Rare RuntimeBroker execution from AppData
primitive_config.content: SELECT process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS run_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\microsoft\runtimebrokers\runtimebroker.exe' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_path HAVING host_count <= 5 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A binary named RuntimeBroker.exe running from a user's Local AppData folder. Silence suggests no such hijack has occurred.

config.objective: Identify hosts where MSBuild staged files in the RuntimeBrokers path followed by execution of RuntimeBroker.exe from that same location.
config.description: Assess whether the MSBuild file creation and the rare RuntimeBroker execution on the same host indicate an active infection.
config.expected_signal: A verdict identifying hosts that show the initial Blinder Tunnel staging and execution chain.
config.success_criteria: A list of compromised hosts with a verdict of suspicious or malicious.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_hostname, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\microsoft\runtimebrokers\%' OR LOWER(process_name) = 'runtimebroker.exe') AND instr(',' || '{{github_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(dst_endpoint_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify process-led connections to GitHub domains from the suspected hijacked process.
config.expected_signal: The suspicious RuntimeBroker process communicating with GitHub API domains.
